description: utopia-php/telemetry: counters, histograms, gauges and observable gauges over the None, Test and OpenTelemetry (OTLP/HTTP) backends, and the keep-alive OTLP transport.

telemetry.otlp.doc: new OpenTelemetry(endpoint, namespace, service, instance, transport) with a transport that keeps every payload

instrument.new.doc: create{Counter,UpDownCounter,Histogram,Gauge,ObservableGauge}(name, unit?, description?, advisory?) by `kind`; `lazy` uses the deprecated ::lazy() shim; `boundaries` is the ExplicitBucketBoundaries advisory

instrument.record.doc: add(value, attributes) on a counter or up/down counter, record(value, attributes) on a histogram or gauge; attributes are [key, value] pairs; `sampled_span` records under an active sampled trace span (PHP only: Rust has no trace context)

instrument.observe.doc: $gauge->observe(callback) where the callback reports every observation in the `source` handle at collection

source.new.doc: fixture: a mutable list of observations {value, attributes} as a handle

memory.dump.doc: the Test backend's public arrays: {counters, upDownCounters, histograms, gauges} as [name, values] pairs, observableGauges as [name, callback count] pairs

memory.observe.doc: runs every callback of the Test backend's observable gauge `name`: [[value, attribute pairs], ...], null when it was never observed

otlp.payloads.doc: every OTLP request the backend sent, decoded: resources, scopes, metrics and points, timestamps as whether they are set

telemetry.replay.doc: records every {kind, name, value, attributes} of `records` on a fresh `backend` (memory, none, otlp), collects twice: {collected, held} (the Test arrays, or the decoded OTLP requests)

transport.new.doc: new Swoole(endpoint, contentType?, headers?, timeout?, poolSize?, socketBufferSize?)

transport.exchange.doc: a scripted local collector ({status, body, delay_ms} | {reset} | {hang_ms} per request) and a transport sending `sends` to it, in order or `concurrent`: {results, requests: [{payload, headers}]}

waivers.Utopia\\Telemetry\\Adapter\\OpenTelemetr: PHP runtime plumbing: the OpenTelemetry SDK's exporter interface, forwarding to the wrapped OTLP exporter; Rust has no SDK exporter layer (the temporality is always cumulative, as cases on otlp.payloads show)
PHP runtime plumbing: the OpenTelemetry SDK's exporter interface, forwarding to the wrapped exporter, unreachable from the adapter's API
PHP runtime plumbing: the OpenTelemetry SDK's exporter interface, forwarding to the wrapped exporter, unreachable from the adapter's API

deviations.php: Attribute values may be arrays or null (null and invalid ones are dropped by the SDK), and `$advisory` is passed to every instrument.
deviations.reason: utopia_telemetry::Value has strings, integers, floats and booleans; the only advisory the SDK honours, histogram bucket boundaries, is Telemetry::histogram's `boundaries`.

deviations.php: Without a transport, the SDK's PSR-18 OTLP HTTP transport is created for the endpoint, and the meter provider is registered globally.
deviations.reason: Rust uses HttpTransport (the port of the Swoole transport) for the endpoint, and has no global meter provider; records under trace spans export no exemplars on either side.
